description: REST API latency regression signal over moltnet-metrics. The source metric is milliseconds. Inspect moltnet-traces by route, then correlate the time window with moltnet-logs. MCP is monitored separately because long-lived GET /mcp SSE connections make completed-request histograms unsuitable for a combined service percentile.
mplQuery:
`moltnet-metrics`:`http.server.request.duration`
| where `service.name` == "moltnet-rest-api"
| bucket by `http.route` to 5m using interpolate_cumulative_histogram(rate, 0.95)
name: MoltNet REST API request latency p95 by route
previousNames: MoltNet request latency p95 by service
